## Saurian Summoner (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
Female lizardfolk summoner (master summoner) 11  
LE Medium humanoid  
**Init** +1; **Senses** Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 12 (20 vs. beams and rays), flat-footed 14 (+2 armor [+8 vs. beams and rays], +1 deflection, +1 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 130 (13d8+26)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +8, **Will** +10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +9 (1d6), bite +9 (1d6)  
**Ranged** hive pistol +11/+6 (1d8/x4)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 11th; concentration +15)  

9/day—summon monster VI  

**Summoner Spells Known** (CL 11th; concentration +15)  

4th (3)—acid pit, mass bull’s strength, wall of stone  
3rd (5)—dispel magic, fire shield, heroism, stoneskin  
2nd (5)—bear’s endurance, create pit (DC 16), glitterdust (DC 16), haste, slow (DC 16)  
1st (6)—endure elements, enlarge person, grease (DC 15), identify, lesser rejuvenate eidolon, unfetter  
0—acid splash (DC 14), detect magic, mending, message, open/close, resistance  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 14, **Con** 12, **Int** 12, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 20  
**Feats** Augment Summoning, Eschew Materials, Evolved Summon Monster, Expanded Summon Monster, Skill Focus (Use Magic Device), Spell Focus (conjuration), Superior Summons  
**Skills** Acrobatics +8, Craft (alchemy) +5, Knowledge (arcana) +8, Knowledge (planes) +8, Linguistics +8, Ride +6, Spellcraft +5, Swim +12, Use Magic Device +23; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Acrobatics  
**Languages** Aquan, Common, Draconic, Ignan, Infernal, Terran  
**SQ** aspect, lesser eidolon, life link, maker’s call, summoning mastery, transposition  
**Combat Gear** potions of cure light wounds (2); **Other Gear** hive pistol with 14 metal cartridges, +1 blue scatterlight suit, ring of protection +1, +2 cloak of resistance, +2 headband of alluring charisma, wand of cure serious wounds (CL 5, 10 charges), wand of mirror image (CL 3, 10 charges), scroll of invisibility purge (CL 5), spell component pouch, 15 gp
